AC amendment: Before the live-validator tests (test_validate_findings_schema_pass_returns_pass_status and test_validate_findings_schema_missing_cited_excerpt_returns_schema_fail), verify that validate-review-output.sh is executable. Add a pytest fixture or assertion:
  assert os.access(validator_script_path, os.X_OK), f'validate-review-output.sh is not executable: {validator_script_path}'
This prevents the live test from silently routing through validator_error instead of the expected pass/schema_fail path. Verify: grep -q 'os.access.*X_OK\|executable' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py
